problem.heading: You don’t need another budget app.
problem.body: You need to know where your money actually goes, what your stuff is really costing you, and what to do next, in order. That is what this playbook gives you, one month at a time.
problem.aside: A clear next step is a very good start.

note.body: I’ve spent years doing the math out loud on the channel. This playbook is everything I’d tell you if we sat at your kitchen table for a year. No shame, no hype, just the next right move, one month at a time.
note.portraitAlt: Alicia sitting at a table, writing in a workbook beside a calculator, envelopes and a mug.

pricing.refundBody: Try the pack with your own numbers. If it isn’t right for you, email us within 30 days for a full refund.

items.q: Is this for me if I’m deep in debt?
items.a: Yes. Tanya’s story starts with $52,000 of debt, a title loan and collections, and her chapters walk through exactly what to do.

items.q: What if I already earn well?
items.a: Kayla, Jess’s best friend, earns $135,000 and is quietly broke. Her story and the high-earner sections cover you.
No. Everything works in free Google Sheets too.

items.q: Is this just the YouTube videos written down?
items.a: No. The book is built on new research, current rules and figures, and practical scripts and setups the channel has never covered.
Instant download right after checkout, plus an email with your links.

items.q: What if I don’t like it?
items.a: Email us within 30 days for a full refund.
No. It is education. For your specific situation, talk to a qualified professional.

steps.label: Turn down the noise
steps.heading: A little less noise. A lot more clarity.
steps.body: You need to know where your money actually goes, what your stuff is really costing you, and what to do next, in order. That is what this playbook gives you, one month at a time.
steps.alt: Alicia gently making a shh gesture while holding a book.

steps.label: Know your numbers
steps.heading: Make the invisible costs visible.
steps.body: Bills. Subscriptions. The things that keep costing after you bring them home. Work with your own numbers, then decide what is worth keeping.
steps.alt: Alicia holding coins and banknotes as the story turns to everyday costs.

steps.label: Build your rhythm
steps.heading: A small routine you can return to.
steps.body: Follow the stories. Keep the checklists close. Give yourself a calm place to sit down, see what changed, and choose the next right move.
